maria (Dev): hey all :wave: I'm embedding a Grafana panel into Confluence for the infra runbook but the iframe shows 403. I have basic grafana read access. anyone seen this?
sam (devex): probable cause = missing 'Embed' permission or the dashboard isn't allowed for anonymous/embed tokens. we use short-lived embed tokens for Confluence. check dashboard settings -> Share -> Embed and make sure 'Enable embedding' is on.
ben (oncall): ping infra-access if it's a permissions thing. we typically issue an embed token via the access form (choose 'Grafana - Embed token').
maria (Dev): where's that form? all I find is the general access request list that mentions Datadog/Grafana/Sentry but not embed tokens specifically.
sam (devex): form is https://redwood.company/internal/access-requests -> option 'Grafana - Embed token'. fields: dashboard UID, target page, TTL (default 7d). FYI tokens expire after 7 days for now.
maria (Dev): thanks — any quick way to test embed locally before Confluence?
carla (eng): you can test with a local html file, basic iframe snippet:
```
<iframe src=\"https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd1234/my-dashboard?orgId=1&kiosk=tv\" width=100% height=600></iframe>
```
If you get 403 there, the token/role is missing. if it renders locally but not in Confluence, Confluence might be stripping headers.
ben (oncall): small tip: if you need a longer-lived integration (dashboards embedded in ops pages), request a service account instead (select 'Grafana - Service account' on the form). that requires an infra review.
maria (Dev): also noticing I can view metrics in Datadog but not traces — is that a separate permission?
carla (eng): yes, APM/traces are gated. request 'datadog-apm-read' on the same access form and include the org/project.
sam (devex): for Sentry access: request 'sentry-project-read' and list project slugs. small workflow note: submit one form per tool to ensure correct approvers route.
maria (Dev): submitted access request for Grafana embed (dashboard UID=abcd1234) via the form. thanks!
devex-bot: Access request submitted by maria (Dev) for 'Grafana - Embed token'. Request ID #4421. Routing to infra-access. Estimated SLA: 1 business day.
maria (Dev): perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup: will follow up if embed still 403 after token approved.
